song.title: Plenio Comes to SoundCraft
song.lyrics:
[Intro]

[Verse]
Hum it in the dark and write it on the screen
Every word I wanted finds a melody
Watch the notes appear on a lane of light
Every take is waiting for the song tonight

[Pre-Chorus]
One idea, one more night
Press generate and hold on tight

[Chorus]
Plenio comes to SoundCraft
Turn it up and play it back
Words and notes on every track
Plenio comes to SoundCraft

[Verse]
Change a single line and let it sing again
Split it into stems and let the drums come in
Every bar in time, the metronome in place
Make it yours and make it new with every take

[Chorus]
Plenio comes to SoundCraft
Turn it up and play it back
Words and notes on every track
Plenio comes to SoundCraft

[Outro]
Every take is yours
